content: शतम् .²1 A hundred; निःस्वो वष्टि शतम् <ls>Śānti. 2. 6</ls>; शतमेकोऽपि संधत्ते प्राकारस्थो धनुर्धरः <ls>Pt. 1. 229</ls>; (शत is used in the singular with a plural noun of any gender; शतं नराः; शतं गावः; or शतं गृहाणि, in which case it is treated as a numeral adjective; but sometimes in dual and plural also; द्वे शते, दश शतानि <ab>&c.</ab> It is also used with a noun in the genitive; गवां शतम्, वर्षाणां शतम् ‘a century of cows, years’ <ab>&c.</ab> At the end of <ab>comp.</ab>, it may remain unchanged; भव भर्ता शरच्छतम् or may be changed into शती; as in आर्यासप्तशती a work of Govardhanāchārya.). .²2 Any large number; as in शतपत्र <ab>q. v.</ab>
